Looking for a bottle you can reach for every day? Sweet Cream Juice Head Salts from Juice Head is a nicotine-salt e-liquid built around a creamy, dessert-inspired profile with a smooth, rounded body. It is stocked and shipped from our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse.

Sweet Cream Juice Head Salts is listed at $11.99 in our Vape Juice range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Vape Juice](/shop/vape-juice/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name Sweet Cream points to a creamy, dessert-inspired profile with a smooth, rounded body. Taste is subjective, and the same flavor can read sweeter or sharper depending on the device and your own palate, so use this as a starting point.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** Juice Head
- **Category:** Vape Juice
- **Flavor:** Sweet Cream
- **Nicotine strength:** 50mg (5%)
- **Price:** $11.99
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Bottle sized for refilling:** the bottle is built for tidy refills and easy storage on a desk or in a bag.
- **Consistent batches:** stocked from the manufacturer's regular production, so repeat orders taste like the last one.
- **Ready-to-use formula:** arrives pre-mixed, so there is nothing to blend and you can fill your device straight away.

### About the strength
This product is listed at 50mg (5%). Compare that figure with what you currently use before you order, remember that nicotine is addictive, and speak to a healthcare professional if you have questions about it.

## Who it suits
Sweet Cream Juice Head Salts suits adult vapers with a refillable pod or tank who want to stay with a flavor they enjoy, and those comparing strengths and bottle sizes before they restock.

## Using and caring for it
Check that your device supports the type of e-liquid you buy: nicotine-salt liquids suit low-power pod systems, while freebase liquids are usually chosen for sub-ohm tanks and higher wattage. Fill slowly, wipe the tip clean, let a fresh coil soak for a few minutes before the first puff, and keep the bottle upright with the cap closed between uses. Store it away from heat and direct sunlight, and keep it away from children and pets.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
You can order Sweet Cream Juice Head Salts online with Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency or gift cards. Pay with crypto or a supported gift card and you save 10% on your order total. Orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free; below that, shipping is a flat $15, and the minimum order is $100.

Orders are processed within 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse and ship with tracking by a regional carrier. Because these are vapor products, an adult aged 21 or older must sign for delivery under the PACT Act, so make sure someone of age can receive the parcel.

## Returns and support
Our returns window is 30 days from purchase. Unopened products in their original packaging qualify, refunds are issued through the same payment method that was used for the order, less a 15% restocking fee, and opened or used items cannot be accepted. Contact us first so we can send an RMA form. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
